links.outcome: Clinician diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance in reader studies
links.effect: AI assistance improved clinicians' skin cancer diagnostic accuracy by 11% on dermoscopy images and nondermatologist providers' differential diagnosis by 16.5% across 128 conditions.
links.quote: PanDerm outperformed clinicians by 10.2% in early-stage melanoma detection through longitudinal analysis, improved clinicians' skin cancer diagnostic accuracy by 11% on dermoscopy images and enhanced nondermatologist healthcare providers' differential diagnosis by 16.5% across 128 skin conditions on clinical photographs.
